title: Carney claps back at Lutnick, says Canada will resume trade talks 'when the Americans are ready'
summary_full: Canada has retaliated against President Donald Trump's 50% tariffs with "dollar for dollar" duties on U.S. goods, which are set to take effect next week.
summary_public: Canada has retaliated against President Donald Trump's 50% tariffs with "dollar for dollar" duties on U.S. goods, which are set to take effect next week.
